item.title: Show HN: UniFi OS Server in Docker
item.summary: Ubiquiti only ships the UniFi OS Server (UOS) as an OCI image embedded inside a proprietary Rust installer — you can't just pull it from a registry. This repository extracts that OCI image, adjusts it to our liking, and ships it with a compose file and config that make it fit to run in Docker. No parallel Podman setup required.
